ruff-n812-lowercase-imported-as-non-lowe.reason: N812-normalized-alias-and-ignored-names.py:15, `from mod import foo as ˤx`: NFKC gives `ʕx`. Unicode 17 made U+0295 a caseless letter (Lo), so Ruff (Rust std, Unicode 17) finds `ʕx` not lowercase and reports it; the engine's regexes use regex-syntax's Unicode 16 tables, where U+0295 is Ll and in \p{Lowercase}, so the translation reads `ʕx` as lowercase. An engine gap (regex Unicode tables), not expressible in the rule without special-casing the character.
